xc_functional.evidence: We also use both the Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) and HSE06 hybrid density functionals to approximate the exchange-correlation interactions.

pseudopotential_type.evidence: The electron-ion interactions are described by the PBE version of the potential dataset generated from the projector-augmented wave (PAW) method.

k_mesh.evidence: We use Γ-centered 12 × 12 × 12 and 12 × 12 × 1 k-point grids for the integration in the reciprocal space for bulk and single-layer PtP2, respectively.

force_threshold_ev_ang.evidence: The unit cells used in both methods consist of two formula units. VASP fully optimizes the in-plane lattice constants and atomic positions of the two unit cells of single-layer PtP2 until the threshold (0.01 eV/˚A) of inter-atomic forces is reached.

energy_threshold_ev.evidence: At each step of the geometry optimizations, we set the total energy convergence to 10−6 eV.

plane_wave_cutoff_ev.evidence: We use the plane waves with their kinetic cutoﬀenergy below 550 eV for approximating the total electron wave function.

vacuum_spacing_ang.evidence: Each surface slab has a vacuum spacing of 18.0 ˚A that is sufficiently large to separate the image interactions.
